requirements.text: The transport SHALL carry INV-36 control messages between host and guest over AF_VSOCK SOCK_STREAM connections on the configured port (default 5036).
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: The transport SHALL mutually authenticate both peers with PK_CTRL_HS/1 before any control message is decoded or dispatched.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Session traffic keys SHALL be derived from the full handshake transcript, binding both identities, both ephemeral keys, both nonces, the offered suite list and the selected suite.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Each session SHALL use fresh ephemeral X25519 keys generated from the OS CSPRNG, providing forward secrecy.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Every control message SHALL be sealed with AES-256-GCM-SIV under direction-specific keys and nonces before leaving the process.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Relays SHALL NOT be able to read plaintext or forge frames; relay-supplied routing metadata SHALL NOT influence authorization.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: The receiver SHALL accept only the exact next sequence number and SHALL reject reordered frames without advancing state.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: The receiver SHALL reject replayed frames and replayed operation IDs without side effects.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Plaintext SHALL NOT exceed 65,536 bytes and wire records SHALL NOT exceed 65,566 bytes; advertised lengths SHALL be validated before payload allocation.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Sending SHALL fail closed before the 64-bit sequence space wraps.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Streams SHALL begin with the PK_CTRL_STREAM/1 preamble; non-matching (legacy or foreign) peers SHALL be rejected before any payload processing.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Every control operation SHALL pass a single mandatory authorization decision (default deny, explicit deny wins) before any handler side effect.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Operations targeting a tenant other than the authenticated principal's tenant SHALL be denied unless an explicitly approved rule allows it.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: When authorization policy is absent, expired or rolled back without recovery authorization, all operations SHALL be denied.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Long-lived keys SHALL be obtained only via secretref:// handles from a KeyProvider and SHALL NOT appear in configuration, logs, evidence, repr or pickles.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Identity key epochs SHALL only increase; the previous epoch SHALL be accepted only within the grace window; rollback SHALL require recovery authorization.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Revoked credentials or key epochs SHALL be refused at handshake; if revocation data is unavailable or stale the handshake SHALL fail closed unless an approved cache window applies.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Failures of the time, trust, attestation or key services SHALL fail new session establishment closed with typed errors.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Configuration SHALL be validated (schema, ranges, cross-field, security) before activation; invalid security-critical configuration SHALL NOT activate; unknown fields SHALL be rejected.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Configuration activation SHALL be atomic, recorded with provenance, rolled back automatically on failed health checks, and SHALL refuse rollback to revoked configurations.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: The component SHALL expose live/ready/degraded health with reason codes, SHALL NOT report ready while a required dependency is down, and SHALL apply hysteresis.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Retries SHALL be bounded, jittered, deadline-aware, budgeted across sessions, and SHALL NOT occur after terminal authentication, authorization, protocol or integrity errors.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Admission SHALL be bounded with high/low water marks and per-tenant quotas; overload SHALL shed optional traffic first and return stable retryable errors.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Calls to failing dependencies SHALL be guarded by a circuit breaker with bounded half-open probing.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Failover SHALL select only residency- and tenant-compatible alternates and SHALL fence stale owners so no two owners are active.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Cryptographic session state SHALL NOT be persisted or resumed; restart SHALL force a new handshake; persisted metadata SHALL be checksummed, versioned and reject corruption.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Quarantine directives SHALL be signed, versioned, time-bounded, scope-validated, require two approvers for broad scopes, override allow policy, and terminate matching sessions on activation.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: An OS-permission-guarded local kill switch SHALL disable session establishment and dispatch when present.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Security-sensitive actions SHALL be recorded in a hash-chained audit log with signed checkpoints whose offline verification detects deletion, insertion, reordering and modification.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Metrics SHALL follow the published catalog with bounded label cardinality and documented units/buckets.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Logs SHALL be structured JSON with stable identifiers, pseudonymized tenant IDs, redacted secrets/payloads and rate-limited repeats; security events SHALL NOT be debug-only.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Trace context SHALL be continued only from authenticated in-estate peers and replaced at untrusted boundaries.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: An operator explain view SHALL summarize health, sessions, policy version, queue pressure, quarantine and recent decision reasons.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: All refusals SHALL map to stable machine-readable error codes (inv36.error/1) with retryability and bounded detail.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Seal+open of a 64-byte frame SHALL have p99 latency <= 50 us on a certified target profile.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: In the reference environment, handshake p99 SHALL be <= 50 ms and control-operation round trip p99 <= 25 ms.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Defaults SHALL cap sessions at 256 per process and 64 per tenant; established-session memory SHALL be <= 256 KiB per session pair.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Under intermittent connectivity the transport SHALL detect stalls via monotonic thresholds, reconnect with jittered backoff and a fresh handshake, and SHALL NOT infer authoritative state from missing messages.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: When requirements conflict, precedence SHALL be: security/integrity > tenant isolation/residency > availability > latency SLO > cost > operator preference.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Peers SHALL speak PK_CTRL_FRAME/2, PK_CTRL_STREAM/1, PK_CTRL_HS/1 and PK_CTRL_MSG/1; unsupported versions SHALL be rejected deterministically.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Channels SHALL follow the lifecycle connecting -> preamble -> authenticating -> ready -> (rekey_due) -> draining -> closed, with quarantine/failure transitions to closed.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Releases SHALL carry an SBOM, in-toto provenance and a signature over artifact digests; verification SHALL fail closed on any mismatch.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Production certification SHALL require a PASS from the pk_core estate gate; SKIP, ERROR or absence SHALL NOT count as PASS.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Parsers for records, frames, messages, handshake messages, configuration, policy and directives SHALL NOT crash or over-allocate on arbitrary input.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Supported deployment contexts SHALL be cloud and datacenter Linux KVM/Firecracker/QEMU hosts; near-/far-edge only where such a host exists; WAN transport is out of scope (GAP-12).
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: Control-channel availability per host/guest pair SHALL be >= 99.95% monthly excluding declared maintenance (proposed SLO).
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: After a process restart with healthy dependencies the endpoint SHALL be ready within 5 s (RTO).
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)

requirements.text: The release gate SHALL fail when license, ownership or governance metadata required by the production exit gate is missing.
requirements.owner: INV-36 technical owner (role; named owner pending MC-21)
